name: Rosa Tommasina Moraca
bioAdditions: Rosa Tommasina was baptized on 5 February 1829 (S1). She married Fortunato Ferlaino on 15 June 1851 (S2). She was buried at San Mango on 11 January 1889, aged 60, as the daughter of the late Francesco Moraca and Francesca Orlando (S3). The baptism index gives her mother as 'Maria' Orlando, but the marriage and burial both say Francesca.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Her son Leopoldo's baptism (image read) names her; baptism, marriage and burial are indexed with consistent parents.
